ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points A, D, C, E are on the same straight line, $AB \parallel EF$, $AB=EF$, $\angle B = \angle F$, $AE=10$, $AC=6$, then what is the length of CD?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB\parallel EF$,\\
$\therefore \angle A = \angle E$,\\
In $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle EFD$,\\
$\angle A = \angle E$, $AB = EF$, $\angle B = \angle F$,\\
$\therefore \triangle ABC \cong \triangle EFD$ (ASA),\\
$\therefore AC = ED = 6$,\\
$\therefore AD = AE - ED = 10 - 6 = 4$,\\
$\therefore CD = AC - AD = 6 - 4 = \boxed{2}$.
